Directory page has no emeritus, adjunct, retired, visiting, joint/secondary, courtesy or incoming listings; the only sections are the main faculty list and "Affiliated Faculty". No announced incoming appointments or start dates appear, so no effective_from dates are recorded.

Page enumerated completely: 31 entries (29 main-list faculty plus 2 under Affiliated Faculty), matching the 31 brief people by name with no omissions in either direction. The "Administration" section (Wei-Jen Lee, David Wetz, Yuze Sun) repeats people already in the main list and adds no one.
Both official profile lookups for the Affiliated Faculty entries (user=jeffery.allen, user=monica.allen) returned "User Not Found"; no further URL patterns were tried.

Titles were read from the page heading HTML (title after the line break, or in the heading text where the name and title share a line), not from the brief title fields; the brief split is not relied on.
